name: Hannah Ivanova
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer with a strong track record of building reliable analytics pipelines, improving data quality, and supporting decision-making across fast-moving teams. Comfortable partnering with stakeholders on system design, modeling, and operational improvements from ingestion through reporting. Known for delivering practical solutions with clear ownership and a steady focus on maintainability.

roles.title: Junior Analytics Engineer
bullets: Built scheduled pipelines with Airflow and Python to move recurring datasets into Snowflake, helping the team deliver fresh reporting each morning.
Wrote SQL transformations and validation checks that reduced manual cleanup by 38% and improved consistency across core metrics.
Partnered with analysts in Agile planning sessions to refine backlog items and ship smaller changes more predictably.
Monitored pipeline runs and resolved failures quickly, keeping data availability above 99% for internal dashboards.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Designed data modeling patterns in SQL and Python that simplified reporting tables and made downstream joins easier to maintain.
Used pandas to profile source data and catch edge cases before load, lowering rework from recurring feeds by 27%.
Reviewed system design choices with product and analytics partners to align warehouse structures with business needs.
Improved documentation for the analytics layer so new teammates could contribute to shared datasets faster.

roles.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built ETL workflows in Python and Spark to process large daily batches into BigQuery and Snowflake for internal reporting.
Used GCP and PostgreSQL to connect operational data sources, standardize extracts, and support a more dependable warehouse refresh.
Applied pandas and SQL for reconciliation checks that cut bad-load incidents by 41% and sped up root-cause analysis.
Tuned pipeline handling around peak volumes so scheduled jobs completed within the required window.

roles.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Led system design for an enterprise data platform using AWS, Azure and BigQuery, aligning storage choices with team ownership and growth plans.
Developed ETL jobs with dbt, Python and Spark to prepare trusted datasets for finance and operations.
Automated deployment scripts with Bash and Git so releases were more repeatable and coordination across teams improved.
Strengthened SQL quality checks and monitoring, reducing pipeline defects by 29% and improving recovery time after failures.
